verdict.rationale: The only documented authentication is a device-code login through omnirush.ai/console, plus bring-your-own OpenAI, Anthropic or 'other provider' API keys. Nothing mentions SSO/SAML/OIDC, an enterprise identity provider, or routing through a cloud platform such as Bedrock, Vertex or Azure. The axis applies to a coding-agent desktop app, but the pack offers no evidence that it delivers this.
